assertion_analysis.tests/test_fleet_health.py:223-229: Literal complete header fails if scheduler/disk fields are dropped, reordered or renamed; its expected list is not imported from the production schema.
assertion_analysis.tests/test_fleet_health_records_node_tmp: Nonzero sampler exit, including a shell-row/schema width mismatch, fails the explicit success assertion.
Losing the source marker or moving/dropping the free-space field fails the literal node and 40 checks; these protect serialization, not independent disk measurement.
Moving the four disk columns ahead of existing columns fails the independent literal suffix list.
Refusing or deduplicating the first scheduler append fails its truth assertion; fixture job/node values only route the row to the file, and are not credited as identity validation.
Omitting the appended scheduler row or truncating the node row fails the literal two-row count.
Changing the previously read persisted node row during append fails the before/after equality; this is a preservation check, not an independent measurement of its original contents.
Losing the supplied terminal event fails the literal end check; populating a scheduler row with disk data fails the literal dash check.
Extra tab-separated fields introduce a None dictionary key and fail; truncated row values are not checked by this assertion, so it is credited only as an excess-field guard.

evidence_limits: No reviewer test rerun or source mutation; source receipt raw SHA-256 values were verified and declared suite failure delta was read from complete logs. The blocking compatibility finding is a direct reading of pinned primary/head schemas and the unchanged suffix validator.

findings.text: Appending four disk fields changes _HEALTH_COLUMNS[-7:] at line 280 from scheduler identity/state columns to a suffix requiring disk columns; a valid existing 25-column health series now raises FleetNodeError, aborting an outside reader restarted before node-side migration or after the allocation ends and losing its terminal scheduler observation. Validate explicit scheduler columns independently of the disk suffix, or migrate compatible series under the shared lock, and cover an existing 25-column series.
